goal: Update the Guix release build environment to newer upstream package releases
Gain access to newer compiler toolchains and eliminate deprecated package definitions
agreement: Verified deterministic builds on x86_64 with matching hashes (0xB10C, willcl-ark)
Unaddressed objection: build fails on riscv64 with an unbound variable error (maflcko)
Unaddressed objection: build fails on an aarch64 host due to missing header directory (janb84, hebasto)
Unaddressed objection: codesign manifest build fails due to missing python-setuptools (willcl-ark)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it updates toolchain versions and cleans up deprecated package manifests
Keeps release build environments current without fixing an active bug or regression
